scripts.docker:prod:infra: docker compose --env-file .env.docker --profile infra -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d postgres redis zookeeper kafka
scripts.docker:prod:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env.docker --profile gateway -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm --no-deps api-gateway npm run db:migrate:deploy
scripts.docker:prod:gateway: docker compose --env-file .env.docker --profile infra --profile gateway -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d api-gateway
scripts.docker:prod:rides: docker compose --env-file .env.docker --profile infra --profile rides -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d ride-service group-ride
scripts.docker:prod:finance: docker compose --env-file .env.docker --profile infra --profile finance -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d payment-service wallet-service
scripts.docker:prod:workers: docker compose --env-file .env.docker --profile infra --profile workers -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d notification-worker defi-scheduler
scripts.docker:prod:core: docker compose --env-file .env.docker --profile infra --profile gateway --profile rides -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d postgres redis zookeeper kafka api-gateway ride-service group-ride
scripts.docker:prod:all: docker compose --env-file .env.docker --profile infra --profile gateway --profile rides --profile finance --profile workers -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
scripts.start:local: npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run start:core-services
scripts.test:wallet-payment-integration: npm run build && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && node test/dist/payment-wallet.integration.js
